title: FIX-AUDIT [N7]: Substitute message-payload construction stays shape-exempt from the hooks lint — its gate is code-review-only
evidence:
client/src/components/reference_panel.gleam:1053-1055:
            event.on_click(msg.UserChoseRefcheckAction(
              call.reference_call_id,
              RefcheckSubstitute,
            )),
scripts/lint_refcheck_hooks.py:143:
            # `(` call arg / `{` import / top-level: exempt by shape
detail: The `(`-context exemption is unconditional: `RefcheckSubstitute` inside a call argument never reaches the `[`-gate check at line 135. A future ungated body surface constructing this message passes CI; only panel tests backstop it.
recommended_fix: Require call-argument constructions to lexically sit inside a hook-gated fn (track fn-level gate state), or move the UserChoseRefcheckAction construction below the `case call.hooks.can_substitute_referee` gate.

title: Hooks lint is evadable via a `!`-negated gate subject or a module-qualified constructor — both pass CI (sandbox-verified)
detail: Sandbox-verified against the shipped lint: `case !call.hooks.can_take_over { True -> [RefcheckTakeOver] }` exits 0 (`!` is untokenised, so the negated subject matches the gate); `[model.RefcheckTakeOver]` exits 0 (dotted token misses HOOK_FOR). Ungated affordance constructions pass CI.
recommended_fix: Reject gate subjects whose token sequence differs from the bare hook field (strip and flag `!`); split dotted tokens and test the final component against HOOK_FOR; add a CI negative-control fixture with both shapes.
